<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>김병헌 · 박현지 — 결혼 알림장 💍</title>
<meta name="description" content="평생 함께 하고픈 반려자를 만나 결혼을 하게 되었습니다. 🌹">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#fffcf8">

<!-- ── Open Graph ── -->
<meta property="og:type"        content="website">

<!-- ── Twitter / X Card ── -->
<meta name="twitter:card"        content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:title"       content="Byeongheon &amp; Hyunji — Finding Forever Together">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="저희 두 사람의 새로운 시작을 축복해 주세요.">
<meta name="twitter:image"       content="og_image.jpg">

<!-- ── KakaoTalk (reads og: tags — keep title ≤45 chars, desc ≤80 chars) ── -->
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'><text y='.9em' font-size='90'>💍</text></svg>">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Gowun+Batang:wght@400;700&family=Gowun+Dodum&family=Lora:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;1,400;1,500&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400;1,500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;background:#fffcf8;color:#222;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden;max-width:480px;margin:0 auto;position:relative;box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,.05);word-break:keep-all;}

/* LANGUAGE */
body.is-en .ko{display:none!important}
body.is-ko .en{display:none!important}

/* LANG PILL */
#langPill{position:fixed;top:1rem;right:max(1rem,calc(50vw - 240px + 1rem));z-index:700;display:flex;background:rgba(255,252,248,.96);border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.15);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-radius:100px;padding:4px;gap:2px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.1);}
.lpBtn{font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem;letter-spacing:.05em;color:rgba(0,0,0,.4);background:transparent;border:none;padding:.4rem .9rem;border-radius:100px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;}
.lpBtn.on{background:rgba(0,0,0,.08);color:#111;}

/* MUSIC PILL */
#musicPill{position:fixed;bottom:1.5rem;right:max(1rem,calc(50vw - 240px + 1rem));z-index:700;}
#musicBtn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;background:rgba(255,252,248,.96);border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.15);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-radius:100px;padding:.5rem 1.1rem .5rem .9rem;color:#444;font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.1);}
#musicBtn.playing{color:#a68345;}
.mbars{display:none;align-items:flex-end;gap:2px;height:12px;margin-left:2px;}
.mbars span{display:block;width:2px;background:#a68345;border-radius:1px;animation:mbar 1s ease-in-out infinite;}
.mbars span:nth-child(1){height:5px}.mbars span:nth-child(2){height:12px;animation-delay:.18s}.mbars span:nth-child(3){height:5px;animation-delay:.36s}
@keyframes mbar{0%,100%{transform:scaleY(1)}50%{transform:scaleY(.3)}}
#musicBtn.playing .mbars{display:inline-flex;}

/* HERO */
#hero{position:relative;width:100%;height:100svh;min-height:600px;overflow:hidden;}
.hero-img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;display:block;}
.hero-grad{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(0,0,0,.15) 0%,transparent 25%,transparent 40%,rgba(0,0,0,.1) 58%,rgba(0,0,0,.65) 80%,rgba(0,0,0,.85) 100%);}
.hero-top{position:absolute;top:2.5rem;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;z-index:10;animation:fu 1.4s .1s both;}
.hero-eye{font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-size:.95rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.3em;margin-right:-.3em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.95);}
.hero-bot{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;width:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding-bottom:2.5rem;z-index:10;animation:fu 1.4s .3s both;}
.h-name-ko{font-family:'Gowun Batang',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(2.3rem,9.5vw,3rem);color:#fff;letter-spacing:.15em;margin-right:-.15em;text-align:center;display:block;}
.h-name-en{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-weight:600;font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(1.9rem,8.5vw,2.6rem);color:#fff;letter-spacing:.05em;margin-right:-.05em;text-align:center;margin-top:.2rem;display:block;}
.h-amp{color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);margin:0 .3em;}
.h-date{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.8rem;margin-top:1.4rem;margin-bottom:2.5rem;width:100%;}
.h-dl{width:32px;height:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.5);}
.h-dt{font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-size:.95rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.15em;margin-right:-.15em;color:#fff;}
.scroll-cue{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;animation:bounce 2s infinite ease-in-out;}
.scroll-icon{width:24px;height:24px;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none;}
@keyframes bounce{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(8px)}}
@keyframes fu{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
#blossom{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;}

/* SECTIONS */
.sec{padding:5.5rem 2.2rem;background:#fffcf8;text-align:center;}
.sec.alt{background:#f8f6f3;}
.slabel{font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.3em;color:#a68345;margin-bottom:2.5rem;display:block;}

/* BODY TEXT */
.body-ko{font-family:'Gowun Batang',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.2rem;line-height:2.1;color:#222;}
.body-ko+.body-ko{margin-top:1.4rem;}
.body-en{font-family:'Lora',serif;font-weight:500;font-size:1.2rem;line-height:2.0;color:#222;}
.body-en+.body-en{margin-top:1.2rem;}
.sig{margin-top:3.5rem;font-family:'Gowun Batang',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.2rem;color:#111;line-height:1.9;}
.rings-orn{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:2.2rem;}

/* DATE */
.styled-date-sec{padding:4.5rem 2.2rem;background:#fffcf8;text-align:center;position:relative;}
.styled-date-sec::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,rgba(0,0,0,.06),transparent);}
.date-ko-phrase{font-family:'Gowun Batang',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.2rem;color:#444;margin-bottom:.8rem;display:block;}
.date-ko-big{font-family:'Gowun Batang',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:2.1rem;color:#111;letter-spacing:.05em;display:block;}
.date-en-phrase{font-family:'Lora',serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:500;font-size:1.2rem;color:#444;margin-bottom:.8rem;display:block;}
.date-en-big{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:600;font-size:2.2rem;color:#111;display:block;}

/* PARENTS */
.parents-sec{padding:4rem 2.2rem;background:#f0ece6;text-align:center;}
.parent-row{font-family:'Gowun Batang',serif;font-size:1.25rem;color:#111;margin-bottom:1.4rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.6rem;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.parent-row:last-child{margin-bottom:0;}
.parent-row span.role{color:#666;font-size:1.1rem;font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-weight:700;}
.parent-row span.name{font-family:'Gowun Batang',serif;font-weight:700;}
.flower-icon{font-size:.85rem;color:#888;vertical-align:middle;}
/* EN parents */
.en-parents-sec{padding:4rem 2.2rem;background:#f0ece6;text-align:center;}
.en-parent-row{font-family:'Lora',serif;font-size:1.2rem;color:#111;margin-bottom:1.2rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.55rem;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.en-parent-row:last-child{margin-bottom:0;}
.en-parent-row span.role{font-family:'Lora',serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;color:#666;font-size:1.1rem;}
.en-parent-row span.name{font-family:'Lora',serif;font-weight:500;}

/* TO EACH OTHER */
.to-each-other-sec{padding:6.5rem 2.2rem;background:#fffcf8;}
.pair-box{margin-bottom:5.5rem;text-align:center;}
.pair-box:last-child{margin-bottom:0;}
.pair-title{font-family:'Gowun Batang',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.3rem;color:#a68345;margin-bottom:1.5rem;display:block;}
.is-en .pair-title{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:1.45rem;font-style:italic;}
.pair-quote{font-family:'Gowun Batang',serif;font-size:1.15rem;line-height:2.2;color:#333;max-width:90%;margin:0 auto;}
.is-en .pair-quote{font-family:'Lora',serif;font-weight:500;font-size:1.2rem;line-height:2.0;font-style:italic;}

/* ABOUT US — vertical stack */
.about-stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2.5rem;margin-top:1rem;}
.about-card{background:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:2.5rem 1.5rem;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.03);border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.02);}
.about-photo{width:130px;height:130px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;margin:0 auto 1.5rem;display:block;border:4px solid #f8f6f3;}
.about-role{font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:700;color:#a68345;margin-bottom:.5rem;letter-spacing:.15em;}
.about-name{font-family:'Gowun Batang',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.6rem;color:#111;margin-bottom:1rem;}
.is-en .about-name{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:600;}
.about-detail{font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;line-height:2;color:#555;}
.is-en .about-detail{font-family:'Lora',serif;font-weight:500;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.9;}

/* GALLERY */
.gal-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:3px;}
.gi{cursor:pointer;aspect-ratio:1;background:#e8e0d8;overflow:hidden;}
.gi img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .4s;}
.gi:active img{transform:scale(1.05);}
.gal-more-wrap{padding:3rem 0 0;text-align:center;}
.more-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;background:transparent;border:none;font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.1rem;color:#666;cursor:pointer;flex-direction:column;}
.more-btn svg{width:26px;height:26px;fill:#888;transition:transform .3s;}
.more-btn.expanded svg{transform:rotate(180deg);}

/* LIGHTBOX — no pinch zoom */
#lb{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:900;background:rgba(0,0,0,.94);justify-content:center;align-items:center;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;}
#lb.show{display:flex;}
#lb-img{max-width:100vw;max-height:100svh;object-fit:contain;touch-action:none;pointer-events:none;-webkit-user-drag:none;}
#lb-close{position:absolute;top:1.5rem;right:1.5rem;color:#fff;font-size:2.5rem;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;width:44px;height:44px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
#lb-prev,#lb-next{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:#fff;font-size:3rem;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:1rem;}
#lb-prev{left:0;}#lb-next{right:0;}
#lb-ctr{position:absolute;bottom:2.5rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;}


/* GIFTS */
.gift-intro{font-family:'Gowun Batang',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.15rem;line-height:2.1;color:#333;margin-bottom:2.2rem;}
.en-gift-intro-box{margin-bottom:2.5rem;text-align:center;}
.en-gift-title{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-weight:600;font-size:1.6rem;color:#111;margin-bottom:1.2rem;}
.en-gift-text{font-family:'Lora',serif;font-weight:500;font-size:1.2rem;line-height:1.9;color:#333;}
.accordion{margin-bottom:1.2rem;background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.04);overflow:hidden;}
.acc-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:1.5rem;font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-size:1.1rem;color:#111;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;}
.acc-chev{transition:transform .3s;font-size:1.2rem;color:#a68345;}
.accordion.open .acc-chev{transform:rotate(180deg);}
.acc-body{display:none;background:#fff;border-top:1px dashed #eee;padding:1.2rem 1.5rem 1.5rem;}
.accordion.open .acc-body{display:block;animation:fadeIn .4s ease;}
@keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-4px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes rvShow{to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.acc-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:1rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.06);}
.acc-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;padding-bottom:0;}
.acc-row-info{flex:1;}
.acc-bank{font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:700;color:#888;display:block;margin-bottom:.3rem;}
.acc-number{font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:700;color:#111;margin-right:.5rem;}
.acc-name{font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:700;color:#555;}
.venmo-box{background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08);border-radius:12px;padding:2.5rem 1.5rem;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.04);}
.venmo-id{font-family:'Lora',serif;font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:600;color:#a68345;margin-bottom:1.8rem;letter-spacing:.05em;}
.crypto-note{font-family:'Lora',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1.05rem;color:#777;line-height:1.7;border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.07);padding-top:1.5rem;margin-top:1.2rem;}
.cbtn{background:#f5f0eb;color:#4a4136;border:none;padding:.7rem 1.2rem;font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:700;border-radius:100px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;}
.cbtn:hover{background:#a68345;color:#fff;}
.cbtn.done{background:#4a7a58;color:#fff;}

/* GUESTBOOK */
.wwall{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;margin-bottom:1.5rem;}
.wcard{background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.07);border-radius:12px;padding:1.4rem 1.6rem;text-align:left;}
.wcard-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:.6rem;}
.wcard-name{font-family:'Gowun Batang',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.1rem;color:#111;}
.is-en .wcard-name{font-family:'Lora',serif;font-weight:600;}
.wcard-rel{font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;color:#bbb;margin-left:.4rem;}
.wcard-side{font-size:.8rem;font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-weight:700;padding:.22rem .7rem;border-radius:100px;border:1px solid;}
.w-bride{color:#a68345;border-color:rgba(166,131,69,.35);background:rgba(166,131,69,.07);}
.w-groom{color:#6a8fa0;border-color:rgba(106,143,160,.35);background:rgba(106,143,160,.07);}
.wtext{font-family:'Gowun Batang',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.95;color:#333;}
.is-en .wtext{font-family:'Lora',serif;font-weight:500;font-size:1.1rem;}
.msg-empty{text-align:center;padding:1rem 0 1.5rem;}
.msg-empty p{font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;color:#ccc;line-height:2;}
.is-en .msg-empty p{font-family:'Lora',serif;font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:400;}
.wform{margin-top:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08);border-radius:20px;padding:3rem 2rem;text-align:left;box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.05);}
.wform-title{font-family:'Gowun Batang',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.5rem;color:#111;margin-bottom:2rem;text-align:center;}
.is-en .wform-title{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:600;font-size:1.6rem;}
.ff{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.8rem;margin-bottom:1.8rem;}
.ff label{font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-size:.95rem;font-weight:700;color:#555;}
.is-en .ff label{font-family:'Lora',serif;font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:500;}
.ff input,.ff textarea{background:#faf8f5;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.1);border-radius:10px;padding:1.1rem;font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:700;color:#111;outline:none;width:100%;transition:border-color .2s;}
.ff textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:120px;}
.ff input:focus,.ff textarea:focus{border-color:#a68345;background:#fff;}
.is-en .ff input,.is-en .ff textarea{font-family:'Lora',serif;font-weight:500;}
.radio-group{display:flex;gap:1.8rem;margin-top:.4rem;}
.radio-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;}
.is-en .radio-label{font-family:'Lora',serif;font-weight:500;font-size:1.15rem;}
.radio-label input[type=radio]{appearance:none;width:24px;height:24px;border:1.5px solid #bbb;border-radius:50%;outline:none;transition:.2s;flex-shrink:0;}
.radio-label input[type=radio]:checked{border-color:#a68345;background-color:#a68345;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 5px #fff;}
.sbtn{width:100%;margin-top:2rem;background:#111;color:#fff;border:none;padding:1.4rem;font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:700;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:.1em;transition:background .2s;}
.is-en .sbtn{font-family:'Lora',serif;font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;}
.sbtn:hover{background:#a68345;}

/* FOOTER */
.footer-quote{padding:7rem 2.2rem 8rem;background:#f0ece6;text-align:center;}
.fq-text{font-family:'Gowun Batang',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.3rem;line-height:2.1;color:#222;}
.is-en .fq-text{font-family:'Lora',serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:500;font-size:1.35rem;line-height:1.95;}
.fq-author{font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem;color:#666;margin-top:1.4rem;}
.is-en .fq-author{font-family:'Lora',serif;font-weight:400;font-size:1.1rem;}
.fq-msg{font-family:'Gowun Batang',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.4rem;line-height:2.1;color:#111;margin-top:4rem;}
.is-en .fq-msg{font-family:'Lora',serif;font-weight:500;font-size:1.3rem;line-height:1.9;}

/* REVEAL */
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease;animation:rvShow 0s 1.2s forwards;}
.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
.rv1{transition-delay:.1s;}.rv2{transition-delay:.2s;}

/* TOAST */
#toast{position:fixed;bottom:2.5rem;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(50px);background:rgba(17,17,17,.96);color:#fff;padding:1rem 2.2rem;border-radius:100px;font-family:'Gowun Dodum',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;opacity:0;transition:all .3s ease;z-index:999;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.25);}
.is-en #toast{font-family:'Lora',serif;}
#toast.show{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);opacity:1;}

/* ── INTRO POPUP OVERLAY ── */
#introOverlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 2000;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  cursor: pointer;
}
#introOverlay::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image: var(--popup-bg);
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center 20%;
  transform: scale(1.04);
  transition: transform 8s ease;
  z-index: 0;
}
#introOverlay.loaded::before {
  transform: scale(1);
}
#introOverlay::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(
    160deg,
    rgba(10, 8, 6, 0.52) 0%,
    rgba(20, 14, 10, 0.62) 45%,
    rgba(15, 10, 8, 0.72) 100%
  );
  z-index: 1;
}
#introContent {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 2rem 2.2rem;
  max-width: 400px;
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
}
.popup-main {
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.6s ease 0.2s;
  min-height: 2.5em;
}
#introOverlay.loaded .popup-main {
  opacity: 1;
}
.popup-title-ko {
  font-family: 'Gowun Batang', serif;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 6vw, 2rem);
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
  letter-spacing: 0.25em;
  margin-right: -0.25em;
  line-height: 1.4;
  display: block;
}
.popup-title-en {
  font-family: 'Lora', serif;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 5.5vw, 1.7rem);
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  line-height: 1.5;
  display: block;
}
#introOverlay.closing {
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.9s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}

</style>
</head>
